description: Spends credits. Identifies the image, checks the price against maxCredits (nothing is charged above it), runs the GPU clean, and saves the result next to the input as <name>.clean.<ext> (never overwrites). Needs DEMARKER_API_KEY. The user must confirm the rights statement: the client asks them when it supports it; otherwise pass rightsAttested true only after the user explicitly agreed to the statement.

keepResolution.description: Keep original size above 12 MP (costs 2 credits).

maxCredits.description: The most this call may spend. Required. 1 credit is one clean up to 12 MP.

outputPath.description: Where to save the result. Must not already exist.

path.description: Absolute path to the input image.

rightsAttested.description: True only if the user explicitly confirmed the rights statement. Ignored when the client can ask the user directly.

vendorHint.description: Where the image was made, if identify found no hidden target.

name: demarker_clean
title: Clean an image (spends credits)
